answer: Assign each identity a narrow earning shard drawn by a public cipher after it joins: verifiable randomness picks one data slice, topic, or tile, and the identity is paid only for work inside its own shard. A farm's thousand clones scatter across a thousand shards, so no single thread of scripted work earns twice - each clone needs genuinely different local knowledge, like reading the grain of its own jade tile. Duplication stops paying; only distinct work in an assigned shard earns.
